canonical_project: Atlantic Hub Data Centre Campus (GreenScale), Foyle Port Innovation Park

location.subnational: Northern Ireland - Derry City and Strabane
location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Derry City & Strabane Planning Committee approved (Sep 2024) the four-storey 22m IT service/data centre building with substation, generators and switchgear at Foyle Port Innovation Park, Maydown; 100MW power connection planned; outline permission for four DCs secured 2020; developer reports site development 2025 and ready-for-service 2027; near Project Kelvin transatlantic fibre landing.
